verdict.rationale: Airwallex Billing documents generating invoices with digital payment links across 160+ local payment methods, issued as one-time or recurring invoices, on top of hosted billing checkout. That covers sending invoices that customers pay online. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic payment reminders or dunning for unpaid invoices, so a core element of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented automatic invoice reminders, explicit detail on the hosted invoice page experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.
